roadTopography.note: R570 to R573, round TOPO-3NOV-D. Button 5 makes one Revit toposolid per NBH from one road surface when the tick Road topography of step 5 is on (R574), read by RoadTopographySettings. All CHOSEN by Code, Bader decides typeName is CHOSEN by Code. surface is CHOSEN by Code. marginM is CHOSEN by Code. limitMm is CHOSEN by Code on the target of Bader of 3 Nov 2026. acceptWarnings is CHOSEN by Code
roadTopography.typeNameWhy: The toposolid type by name, so a project names its own. Button 5 duplicates a type of the model under this name when the model has none
roadTopography.surfaceWhy: The first of designBasis.roadLevel.surfaces, the surface most ramp road corners take their level from (R491). The build must have read it, so a pick of road surfaces without it stops the toposolid with a line and not the floors
roadTopography.marginMWhy: The convex hull of the plots stops at the plot lines, and the road edges of the ramps lie on them. 5 m takes in the road in front of them, and more only adds road of the next NBH
roadTopography.limitMmWhy: The target of Bader of 3 Nov 2026: a ramp road edge meets the toposolid within 5 mm. A larger difference is counted and listed, it stops nothing
roadTopography.minCoverShareWhy: Under this share of the ramp road edge points on the surface, the surface does not cover the scope and no toposolid is made. NBH 012 holds all 1008 points on it, half tells a surface of another part of the site from a few plots off it
roadTopography.pointGapMWhy: Two points this near are one, and a boundary corner this near the last is dropped, since Revit refuses a curve under about 0.8 mm and two levels a few mm apart in plan only make a spike
roadTopography.acceptWarningsWhy: R575. Revit said it 782 times at the commit of NBH 012 and stopped the press at its box, with no floor cut or changed. Words not named here still show
roadTopography.maxPointsWhy: Thinning starts over this count. RevitAPI.xml 2024 names no limit of points on a toposolid, 10000 is the count Revit is known to warn of on a toposurface, NBH 012 holds 95177 points after pointGapM, and the Revit run of the round checks it

dataCheck.groupGapsWhy: standInMaxArea is CHOSEN by Code (R601), an outline with no number that lies inside no plot and is no larger than 4 times the median plot stands in the distance test for a plot with no number, so the gap it leaves is no road, a larger outline is no stand in. groupGapsM is CHOSEN by Code (R601). One distance for each group level, the largest group first. Plots whose outlines lie within the distance of each other, in a chain, are one group of that level. 1 m joins plots that touch or share a wall line and parts the plots a road apart, 100 m joins the blocks of an area across its roads and parts areas that lie apart.
dataCheck.wordWhy: wordReachM is CHOSEN by Code (R603). wordShare is CHOSEN by Code (R603). wordMinGroups is CHOSEN by Code (R603). A text of two or more words outside every plot and within 30 m of one names a group when its words before the last one are the same for 90 % of the groups of a level and each group has its own last word. valueStatus.note: R401. The status of each sourced value of a plot of the plan, by its field and its source, from the block status of the rules profile. fields holds a field, parameters.* for every parameter, and per source the list of the block entries the code that computes the value reads, each by its path in the rules profile (profile) or in this file (config), where {levelProfile} is the level profile of the build, {parameter} the parameter name, {hand} the hand table the plot took and {unit} the unit code of the plot, or the status itself. prototypeFile lists the unit of the location plan, the file of the prototype folder named with it and the keo_file of its typology, which the code reads for every typology (Q110). A field majority.decidedByQuestion lists for a plot under an open question adds the block entry of that question and key, majority.decidedByQuestion.<Q>.plots.<key>, so it takes the worst of its list, RECOMMENDED by that question while it is open (review 1 of PR 78). A value takes the worst status of its list in the order of worstFirst, else the status of the first entry, and lists each (Q107). sources holds a source for every field. A pair neither holds, or an entry the block lacks, is UNKNOWN. overrideSets names per override of the list every field it moves or decides, the mirror flag the outline and type of the yard as it picks the outline group of the hand, a rotation override the ends, base and top of a wall, named only on a wall that stands on the front of R355 the turn moved from, as the turn decides only whether a wall stands and the plots of a wall come from the faces (Q120), and the outline, corners and heightOffset of the ramp, named only on a plot whose ramp the turn moved to the open edge (Q116), which then takes the status of the source override, and the value names every applied override whose set holds the field, the overrides that touched its inputs, in the order the build applied them (Q112, Q113). A frontEdge line (R482, Q299) sets the front of its plot by hand, so every value that stands on the front takes its set and reads the rules it leaves, the rule of the front out, so a hand pick never reads as a rule measure, and the mirror flag with what follows it as the road side of the front feeds the hand table. worstFirst names the statuses worst first. overrideReads names per override the fields it moves that the code still computes from other entries, with those entries, so such a field takes the worst of the override status and them, and a field of overrideSets it does not name the override sets outright (Q107). A value several overrides touched names them all and reads the entries every override that set an input it stands on still reads for its field, as each reads the inputs it leaves, none when one sets it outright (Q119, R1 of the review of PR 85). The base and the top of a wall read those of the overrides of the plot of their level, and the entries of their own field where that plot holds none. A field such an override touched takes the worst of the override status and the entries overrideReads names for it, also where it equals its value with no override (Q113). assumed names the statuses the plan summary lists by plot, MEASURED with its strength.

coordinates.note: R454 to R456, Lane B FIX-1NOV-B. The coordinate system and site position button 1 takes from CAD. source cad reads them with the worker command crs (addin.workerTimeLimitS.crs, 600 s until a run measures it), positionFile keeps the position file of addin.position, CHOSEN until the Revit run proves cad (Q328). Each key below has a sentence of its own, so its status takes the question of that sentence. coordinates.systems maps a system name an input states to its EPSG code (Q325). coordinates.expectedEpsg is the code every stated system must be (Q325), also the code of the math when no input states one. coordinates.originRoundM rounds the shared origin (Q326), the centre of the box of the plot outlines of the baseplan. coordinates.originElevationM is the survey point height (Q327), 0 until Bader picks a CAD source of it. coordinates.angleToTrueNorthDeg is true north (Q328), 0 for the grid of the drawing. coordinates.positionName names the named position (Q328). coordinates.placeName is the place of the site location (Q328), null keeps the one of the document. coordinates.controlPointCount plot corners far apart are checked (R456, Q329). coordinates.controlPointLimitMm is the gap a control point passes at (R456, Q329). coordinates.utmEastM is the easting a UTM zone is valid in (CHOSEN), by the UTM definition on WGS 84. coordinates.utmNorthM is the northing of a zone north of the equator (CHOSEN), up to 84 degrees north. coordinates.utmSouthNorthM is the northing of a zone south of it (CHOSEN), from 80 degrees south. Under source cad a box of the plot outlines outside them stops button 1 (R455). coordinates.newProjectSource is the source Empty project writes into the settings (R511, Q415), and source stays positionFile so a saved past job and the proof do not move. coordinates.noCoordinatesLimitMm is the gap of zero (CHOSEN, R510) for the project position, survey point and base point, half a mm as R331. coordinates.noCoordinatesLimitDeg is the angle of zero (CHOSEN, R510), a millionth of a degree as R331. coordinates.typedOffBoxLimitM is how far (CHOSEN, R513) a typed origin may lie off the box of the plots before it stops button 1, under it the window warns.
